visual.heroDirection: Use luminous, sharply detailed compositions of pins, coins, medals, keychains, ribbons, hardware, and finish samples. Let the objects and color lead the page, keep headline space clear, and avoid generic offices or industrial equipment styling.
visual.imageRules: Show the object at an aspirational scale: enamel color, edge depth, relief, plating, attachment, ribbon, leather grain, reverse side, and presentation. Treat every temporary image as a replaceable visual reference, never as proof of company work.
